name: Glitter Nurse Badge Buddy Card (Horizontal)
seoTitle: Glitter Nurse Badge Buddy Card for ID Badges
metaDescription: A glittery horizontal badge buddy card that shows the nurse title at a glance. A sparkly, practical little gift for nurses and nursing students.
summary: A sparkly badge buddy that sits behind an ID and makes the wearer's role easy to spot. Small, useful, and fun to give.
whyItWorks: Patients meet a long line of people in scrubs during a hospital stay, and they often cannot tell who is the nurse, the tech, or the transporter. Badge buddies solve that with large, readable role text that sits behind the ID. A glitter version keeps the practical purpose but adds a bit of personality, which is welcome on a unit where everyone is dressed in matching navy or ceil blue.

As a gift, a badge buddy is low risk and genuinely used. It slides in behind a badge and stays there, so it gets seen every single shift. Glitter makes it a fun pick for a coworker who already decorates her reel or wears colorful scrub caps. It also suits nursing students who are about to start their first job and want their title front and center. Add a matching badge reel for a small set.
goodToKnow: The horizontal format suits horizontal ID badges, so check which way her hospital badge is oriented.
Check the listing to confirm the exact wording and glitter color on the card.
Some facilities issue their own role badges, so it is worth knowing her unit's policy.

faq.a: It is a card that sits behind or below a work ID and shows the wearer's role in large text. Nurses use them so patients can quickly see who their nurse is.
This one is horizontal, so it suits badges that are wider than they are tall. If her ID is vertical, look for a vertical badge buddy instead.
